q: Which planet is closest to the Sun in our Solar System? (P6)
explain: Mercury orbits nearest to the Sun at an average distance of ~58 million km.

q: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet' due to iron oxide on its surface? (P6)
explain: Mars has reddish iron oxide dust covering its terrain.
hint: Named after the Roman god of war.

q: A Solar Eclipse occurs when the ____ passes directly between the Sun and the Earth. (P6)
explain: During a solar eclipse, the Moon's shadow falls onto Earth.
hint: Earth's natural satellite blocks the sun.

q: A Lunar Eclipse occurs when the ____ passes directly between the Sun and the Moon. (P6)
explain: Earth blocks sunlight from illuminating the full Moon.
hint: Our home planet casts a shadow on the moon.

q: Which gas in the Earth's atmosphere is most abundant (approx. 78%)? (P6)
explain: Nitrogen makes up roughly 78% of dry atmospheric air, followed by oxygen at 21%.
hint: Makes up almost 4/5 of the atmosphere.

q: Acids turn blue litmus paper ____. (P6)
explain: Acidic solutions (pH < 7) turn blue litmus paper distinctly red.
hint: Remember: Acid turns Blue to Red (ABR).

q: Bases (alkalis) turn red litmus paper ____. (P6)
explain: Basic/alkaline solutions (pH > 7) turn red litmus paper blue.
hint: Bases turn red to Blue (B -> Blue).

q: The atmospheric layer that absorbs harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation from the sun is the ____ layer. (P6)
explain: The stratospheric ozone (O3) layer shields life from dangerous UV rays.

q: The process by which living organisms maintain a stable internal body environment is ____. (P6)
explain: Homeostasis regulates body temperature, blood sugar, and water balance.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): What is the chemical formula of pure water?
explain: H₂O is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): Which organ pumps blood in the human body?
explain: Heart is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): Which gas do humans inhale for cellular respiration?
explain: Oxygen is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): Which gas do green plants absorb during photosynthesis?
explain: Carbon dioxide is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): What is the freezing point of pure water at sea level?
explain: 0°C is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): What is the boiling point of pure water at standard atmospheric pressure?
explain: 100°C is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The female reproductive cell in humans and animals is the ____.
explain: ovum (egg) is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The male reproductive cell in animals is the ____.
explain: sperm is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): Animals that eat ONLY plants are called ____.
explain: herbivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): Animals that eat ONLY meat and other animals are called ____.
explain: carnivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): Animals that eat BOTH plants and meat are called ____.
explain: omnivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The largest organ of the human body is the ____.
explain: skin is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The framework of bones that supports and protects human organs is the ____.
explain: skeleton is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): Sound cannot travel through a ____ because there are no particles to vibrate.
explain: vacuum (empty space) is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): Which energy is obtained directly from the sun?
explain: Solar energy is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): Which planet is the largest in our solar system?
explain: Jupiter is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): Which planet is famous for its bright, prominent rings?
explain: Saturn is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The process by which seeds begin to sprout and grow into young seedlings is ____.
explain: germination is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma of a flower is ____.
explain: pollination is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The loss of water vapour from the leaves of plants through stomata is ____.
explain: transpiration is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The powerhouse organelle inside animal and plant cells that produces energy is the ____.
explain: mitochondrion is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The control center of a biological cell containing genetic DNA is the ____.
explain: nucleus is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The rigid outer protective layer found in plant cells but absent in animal cells is the ____.
explain: cell wall is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The force of attraction between any two masses in the universe is ____.
explain: gravitation is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P6): The measure of how much matter is packed into a given volume is called ____.
explain: density is the scientifically verified fact.
